v1.feedback: The snap-recoil-heal narrative is well-conceived and maps the 'elastic-snap' prompt literally onto the Saraceno web lineage — good conceptual fidelity. However, 260 random nodes connected by proximity edges at 0.22 line opacity will likely read as a faint, amorphous point cloud rather than a structured web; Saraceno's power comes from radial/spiral tensile geometry, and this piece lacks that architectural legibility. Increase line opacity to ~0.35, add a secondary radial or catenary organizational layer so the silhouette reads as 'web' within 2 seconds, and consider a very slow single-axis camera drift (non-Y) to reveal the 3D depth of the network structure.

v2.feedback: The orb-web form is immediately legible and the elastic-snap mechanic directly serves the prompt word — periodic tension releases ripple through the structure convincingly. Palette is well-restrained steel-blue on near-black. For refinement: the web is nearly flat (z ±0.9 across radius 13) making it read as a 2D diagram rather than a sculptural object — adding gentle catenary sag between rings or a slight conical/bowl warp would give it depth and better reward the camera breathing. Consider fewer, more dramatic snaps (every 15–20s instead of 6–10s) so each event feels like an event rather than background fidget.
